sample.selection: first records in the registry's default order, keeping unique https streamable-http remote URLs
sample.bias: Not random. The registry's default order is alphabetical by server identifier, so the sample over-represents names beginning with 'a'. A re-run is a new measurement, not a regression test: these servers deploy.
sample.transport_coverage: streamable-http remote endpoints only; the stdio population is larger and unreachable by this method
